headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 31, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson's impressive performance included three home runs and six RBIs. The Washington Nationals suffered a 6-3 defeat at the hands of the Philadelphia Phillies, with Derek Hill leading the Nationals' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Colorado Rockies left-handed pitcher Sean Sullivan has been placed on the 15-day injured list, retroactive to July 5, 2026. The Chicago Cubs transferred RHP Ben Brown from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a neck strain. The Milwaukee Brewers placed LHP JoJo Romero on the 15-day injured list.

The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson's impressive performance included three home runs and six RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling 4-3 Win Over Brewers**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers in a close matchup, securing a 4-3 victory. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 3 RBIs on a single hit in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall to Cubs in 5-10 Thrashing**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Los Angeles Dodgers, securing a 5-10 victory. Michael Busch led the Dodgers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies LHP Sean Sullivan Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left-handed pitcher Sean Sullivan has been placed on the 15-day injured list, retroactive to July 5, 2026. This move comes as a result of an ongoing injury issue.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. This move adds depth to the Athletics' pitching rotation.
